stet.definition:
v. printing: cancel, as of a correction or deletion
v. printing: direct that a matter marked for omission or correction is to be retained (used in the imperative)
stet.translation:
n. 表示'不删'/'保留'
vt. 对...加注表示'不删'/'保留'的符号

stethography.translation: [医] 胸动描记法; 心音描记法

stethometer.definition:
n. An apparatus for measuring the external movements of a
   given point of the chest wall, during respiration; -- also called
   thoracometer.

stethophonometer.translation: [医] 胸音计, 听诊测音器

stethoscope.definition: n. a medical instrument for listening to the sounds generated inside the body
stethoscope.translation:
n. 听诊器
vt. 用听诊器诊断

stethoscopes.definition: n. a medical instrument for listening to the sounds generated inside the body
stethoscopes.translation: n. 听诊器( stethoscope的复数形式 )

stethoscopic.translation:
a. 听诊器的
[医] 听诊器的

stethoscopical.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a stethoscope; obtained or made
   by means of a stethoscope.

stethoscopist.definition: n. One skilled in the use of the stethoscope.
stethoscopist.translation: n. 擅长听诊的医生；能熟练使用金属探伤器的人

stethoscopy.definition: n. The art or process of examination by the stethoscope.
stethoscopy.translation:
n. 听诊, 听诊法
[医] 听诊器检查

stets.definition:
v printing: cancel, as of a correction or deletion
v printing: direct that a matter marked for omission or correction is to be retained (used in the imperative)
stets.translation: v. 在已经删除的稿边上写stet( stet的第三人称单数 )

stetson.definition: n a hat made of felt with a creased crown
stetson.translation: n. 斯泰森毡帽（一种阔边高顶毡帽）

stetsons.definition: n. a hat made of felt with a creased crown
stetsons.translation: n. 斯泰森毡帽（一种阔边高顶毡帽）( Stetson的复数形式 )

stetted.translation: v. 在已经删除的稿边上写stet( stet的过去式和过去分词 )

stettin.translation: (=Szczecin)斯德丁(波兰西北的一个城市)

stetting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Stet
stetting.translation: v. 在已经删除的稿边上写stet( stet的现在分词 )
